test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Heavy outfits make the movement of trekkers **__sluggish__**.
solution: The correct answer is **"Active."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Sluggish'** means slow and lacking energy. (सुस्‍ती भरी धीमी गति से चलने या काम करने वाला; ढीला-ढाला) • **Example: ***A heavy lunch makes me **sluggish**__ in the afternoon.* • **'Active'** means lively and full of energy. (सक्रिय, क्रियाशील; चुस्‍त, फुरतीला, जीवंत) __ • **Example:** *My grandfather is very **active**__ for his age.* • *​*The most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word is **"Active.'** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Distorted** means twisted or deformed. (शकल या आवाज़ को बिगाड़ देना) • **Eye-catching **means attractive or attention-grabbing. (सुंदर होने के कारण तुरंत ध्यान आकृष्‍ट करने वाली (वस्‍तु)) • **Comfortable** means relaxed and at ease. (आरामदेह, सुखद) 45:T85c, The correct answer is **"nor rebuilding."**
